key_points: Completion of the 13-satellite O3b mPOWER constellation validates Boeing Space execution and supports defense growth.
Pentagon awards and Saudi JDAM-ER work add defense revenue visibility.
Potential NASA Starliner missions could expand Boeing's strategic LEO opportunity, but remain unconfirmed and execution-risky.
FAA, production and possible labor-strike risks offset some upside.
China-order expectations and analyst commentary are largely speculative noise.
